### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** 16da33489180e4d0b381db65048e434d0d9c3710
* **CI workflow:** ci.yml Script Tests job (test-batched.sh runner, 120s per-test timeout)
* **Affected file:** tests/scripts/test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh
* **Local:** unknown — likely passes (timeout is CI-runner-specific)

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** Deferred Review Nitpick

#### Expected Behavior

Script Tests job should complete with FAILED: 0 on green PRs. Each individual test should run under the 120s per-test ceiling enforced by test-batched.sh.

#### Actual Behavior

test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh consistently TIMEOUT (exceeded 120s) on CI runners, causing Script Tests job to report FAILED: 1 despite the other 5882 tests passing.

Pre-existing on main:
- Run 25891399809 (Merge PR #125 to main, 2026-05-14): test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh TIMEOUT (exceeded 120s) — FAILED: 1
- Run 25895757298 (worktree-20260514-182810, 2026-05-15): same test, same timeout, FAILED: 1

The TIMEOUT path produces an empty failure-output capture in the test-batched.sh output bracket ('=== test-implementation-plan-helpers.sh === <empty> --- end ---'), giving no diagnostic detail.

### 3. Action History

Observed on two consecutive CI runs (one on main, one on a fresh feature branch) without code changes to the affected test or its dependencies.

### 6. Logs

Run 25891399809: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/25891399809
Run 25895757298: https://github.com/navapbc/digital-service-orchestra/actions/runs/25895757298
